meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取项目在 claude-mem 中的完整时间线，生成一篇题为“Journey Into [项目名]”的叙事报告，内容涵盖项目起源、架构演变、关键突破等，并保存为 markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求写时间线报告、分析项目历史、总结开发历程等时触发。若无明确项目名，Claude 会先询问要分析哪个项目。

say.note: 触发后 Claude 会先确认项目名

say.text: 分析这个项目的开发历程
say.note: Claude 会读取时间线并生成报告

say.text: 给我写份 Journey Into 这个项目的完整报告
say.note: 报告将保存为 markdown 文件

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the project's full timeline from claude-mem and generates a long-form narrative report titled 'Journey Into [project]', covering origins, architecture evolution, key breakthroughs, etc., and saves it as a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, etc. If no project is named, Claude asks which project to analyze.

say_en.note: Claude will ask which project to analyze first
Claude reads the timeline and produces a report

say_en.text: Write a full 'Journey Into' report for this project
say_en.note: The report will be saved as a markdown file
